name: models : fix mimo2 swa pattern load (#28865)
summary: Merged llama.cpp pull request fixing MiMo-V2 model load: the SWA pattern lookup wrongly used get_key_or_arr (fixes #28831).
description: Pull request #28865 in ggml-org/llama.cpp, merged 14 Sep 2026 by ggerganov. It fixes MiMo V2 model loading: the SWA pattern update was missed for MiMo V2 and get_key_or_arr should not be used there, which made MiMo-V2.5-Pro fail to load with an hparam error. Continues #28159.
contains: closes issue #28831: MiMo-V2.5-Pro fails to load with hparam error
